description: List EveryInfra's data platforms and capabilities (90 platforms / 413 capabilities: search, detail, comments, profiles and more). Use it before everyinfra_call_api to get the platform/action, required and optional params, the per-call row limit (max_limit, or page_size for page-based actions) and the price. Pass a platform to also get allowed values, returned fields and what they mean. Free. Data collection only — for AI chat use everyinfra_chat.

platform.description: Optional; only this platform's capabilities, e.g. xiaohongshu / twitter / tiktok

name: everyinfra_list_capabilities
title: List data capabilities
